Students not wishing to complete a specialisations should select `Electrical Stream Electives`. Students may like to initially select the Stream Electives option and choose a specialisation after their first year.

A stream specialisation is a subset of stream electives relevant to a particular aspect of Electrical Engineering, such as Intelligent Information Engineering or Telecommunications. A breadth specialisation broadens your knowledge outside the field of Electrical Engineering in areas such as Engineering Data Science or Innovation and Entrepreneurship. If you opt to take a breadth specialisation, it takes the place of your free electives.
